{{Quote|You should try the Fermented Blue Milk. It's excellent!|A bartender, to a spacer|<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Blue milk''', sometimes known as '''bantha milk'''<ref name="MW">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: MidWorld}}</ref> and '''Tatooine milk''',<ref name="Rogue Planet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref> was a nutrient-rich<ref name="CCG A New Hope">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Blue Milk}}</ref> [[Color/Legends|blue-colored]] liquid produced by a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bantha/Legends|bantha's]] mammary glands. It could be found on most [[Planet/Legends|planets]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Blue milk could also be fermented into an alcoholic version.<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> The milk was also used to make a variety of yogurt, [[Ice cream/Legends|ice cream]], and [[Blue cheese|cheese]], and it was rumored to have medicinal qualities.<ref name="CCG A New Hope" /> Its ubiquity inspired the military phrase "[[Blue milk run/Legends|blue milk run]]."<ref name="BMR">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] served chilled blue milk in whole and short-wavelength varieties at a price of 1.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for a small serving or 2.3 credits for a large.<ref name="Dex's" />
